Vejle is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report functions as a major instrument for local quality development and benchmarking in the Danish healthcare system, evaluating clinical treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. 

Vejle's specific significance in this corpus lies in its inclusion in the data for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant treatment among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. The municipality's stroke event data is derived from the DanStroke database [^src1]. In the report's detailed municipal breakdown, Vejle is listed with 13 recorded events out of a cohort of 2,580 patients, alongside the statistical values 0.5 and 0.8 [^src1]. Because the available evidence is limited to this single tabular entry, no further narrative, historical, or administrative details about Vejle are documented in the provided texts.
